item.name: Accept EOR project assignment as client

request.name: Accept EOR project assignment as client

description.content:
Utilize this endpoint to accept a project assignment for an EOR contract once the client has reviewed and approved the terms.
 **Token scopes**: `contracts:write`

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the employee contract.

response.name: The project assignment was accepted successfully.

  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN-HERE'

description.content:
Utilize this endpoint to retrieve the PDF of the project assignment for an EOR contract that a client is required to approve.
 **Token scopes**: `contracts:read`

query.description: This field is to ensure that the latest version of the project assignment PDF matches the version received from the webhook. If it is not sent, the version validation is not performed and the endpoint returns the PDF. If it is sent, it is checked whether the current version is equal to the version sent; if not, a 409 error occurs, otherwise, the PDF is returned.

item.name: Fetch Project Assignment Checkin Questionnaire Data

request.name: Fetch Project Assignment Checkin Questionnaire Data

description.content:
Use this endpoint to fetch the project assignment checkin data with all necessary information to render in your side the questionnaire
 **Token scopes**: `contracts:read`

query.description: This field is to ensure that the latest version of the project assignment checkin matches the version received from the webhook. If it is not sent, the version validation is not performed. If it is sent, it is checked whether the current version is equal to the version sent; if not, a 409 error occurs, otherwise, the data is returned.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the contract.

response.name: Successful response containing form configuration data.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the contract.
